_what_this_is: Which founder occupies which voting contestant id. One file, one decision, reversible by editing it and re-running tools/build-founders.py.
_why_reviewed_is_false: This mapping was derived from the order of rows in the Top 20 sheet, and the manifest says in terms that sheet order is NOT an approved ranking or id assignment. Nobody has confirmed it.
Until reviewed is true the voting page carries a visible staging notice saying the assignment is provisional, so no vote cast on staging can be mistaken for a confirmed one.

Changing this file changes only which NAME appears against an id. It moves no vote. Vote rows reference entrant-NN and nothing else, and entrant ids are generated identically by pc_entrants() in pc-lib.php and slot() in peoples-choice.js.
